protected_regular_1.description: fs.protected_regular=1 (default here 0); otherwise the control configuration.
protected_regular_1.prediction_basis: protected_regular only refuses an O_CREAT open of an EXISTING regular file that the opener does not own in a sticky directory whose owner is not the file owner. The only probe-02 step of that shape is the recorder's O_CREAT|O_APPEND onto the agent's pre-created next-session file in the sticky layouts, and that step is already refused with EACCES by the file's 0644 mode, so its recorded outcome and errno cannot change. O_CREAT|O_EXCL returns EEXIST before the sysctl is consulted.

not_run_variants.bind_mount_separate_records_workspace: not_run: the committed fixture places the agent workspace next to the records tree under ONE probe root for every ordinary, legitimate-proxy and descriptor measurement; only the two fill controls accept a separate workspace filesystem, and those must be dedicated tmpfs mounts of at most 8 MiB (fixture.fill_root_problem). Putting records and workspace on different bind-mounted filesystems for the ordinary operations (where rename_out_of_dir, replace, hardlink_create and the symlink swaps would cross a filesystem boundary) therefore needs a change to the frozen fixture, which was not made. The separate-filesystem case IS exercised for the fill control in bind_mount_ext4, where the two fill filesystems are separate bind mounts.

effect_control_prediction_basis: fs.rst: protected_regular=1 refuses O_CREAT opens of regular files the opener does not own in world-writable sticky directories unless the directory owner owns the file; =2 also in group-writable sticky directories. protected_symlinks=1 refuses following a symlink in a sticky world-writable directory unless follower and link owner match or the directory owner owns the link. O_CREAT|O_EXCL fails with EEXIST on any existing name, including a symlink.
